RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the February 18, 2009/Magha 29, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Defence; Earth Sciences; Home Affairs;
Labour and Employment; Rural Development ;
Science and Technology; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
15
Clearances to FDI proposals
*41. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Finance Ministry has given
its clearance to 32 FDI proposals worth
Rs. 846 crores;
(b) if so, whether a decision of 3 media
companies proposal has been deferred; and
(c) if so, what are other proposals
pending with Government and by what
time all proposals of FDI will be cleared
and to what extent it will help to meet
financial crisis?
Implementation of Building and
Other Construction Workers' Act
  †*42. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Building
and Other Construction Workers
(Regulation of Employment and
Conditions of Services) Act, 1996 had been
implemented in the country about 12 years
back;
(b) if not, the date of implementation of
aforesaid law;
(c) whether State Governments had
been empowered to collect cess for the
welfare of workers under this Act;
(d) if so, the State-wise amount collected
under this head till March, 2008; and
(e) the names of States where this
collection was done and the names of
schemes formulated out of this amount for
welfare of workers?
Traffic problems at Gol Dakkhana in
Delhi
†*43. SHRI RAJNITI PRASAD: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether pedestrians have to face a
lot of problems due to carelessness of traffic
police while walking along the round about
situated at Delhi Institutional Zone (DIZ)
area;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

16
(b) if so, whether it is almost impossible
for pedestrians to cross Kalibari Road at
Gol Dakkhana roundabout or to go to Gol
Dakkhana;
(c) whether a lady Member of Rajya
Sabha has also given some suggestions
regarding traffic regulation at this site
keeping in view the problems being faced
by school going children/their guardians,
but the traffic police has not taken any
action on these suggestions; and
(d) the time by when the Ministry will
be in a position to ensure the removal of
these traffic hurdles and take proper action
against persons responsible for this
carelessness?
Employment under NREGS
*44. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of households which
requested for employment under the
National Rural Employment Guarantee
Scheme (NREGS) and who were provided
employment, State-wise during 2006-07,
2007-08 and 2008-09;
(b) how many of above got 100 days
employment;
(c) the average days of employment for
each household; and
(d) whether the above can be called
'Satisfactory'?
Improving facilities to handloom
weavers in U.P.
*45. SHRI NAND KISHORE Y ADA V:
SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the efforts made by
Government to improve the facilities to
handloom weavers in Uttar Pradesh (U.P.)
during the last three years, district-wise;
(b) how many handloom weavers in
U.P. are covered under the various schemes
during the last three years, district-wise;
(c) whether Government will implement
health insurance scheme for the weavers
and their families in U.P.;
(d) if so, the details thereof, district-
wise; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Participation of children in Republic
Day celebrations
*46. SHRI MOHD. ALI KHAN: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether children's participation was
not there in the Republic Day celebrations
this year as  compared to the last year;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps being taken to include
children's participation from next year?
Medical representatives in the
country
*47. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY: Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the State-wise number of medical
representatives in the country;
(b) whether they are covered by the
definition of 'workman' under the Industrial
Disputes Act; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?

17
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Acquisition of land for setting up of
industries
†*48. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that despite clear
directions of the Central Government,
complaints pertaining to the acquisition of
agricultural land in some States, have been
received by Government;
(b) the States where the process of
setting up of industries has been started on
the land acquired from the farmers; and
(c) whether Government has prescribed
a time limit for setting up of industries on
the acquired land?
Increase in population of North
Eastern States
†*49. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to refer to
answer to Unstarred Question 1328 given
in the Rajya Sabha on the 12th March, 2008
and state:
(a) the district-wise increase in
population of Hindus, Muslims, Christians
and Buddhists in Assam and the North
Eastern States in the census of 2001 as
compared to census of 1991 and also as
per the estimates as on date;
(b) the number of persons who came
through legal means and those who
migrated from Bangladesh illegally;
(c) the number of persons out of this
population whose names have been
included in electoral roll and BPL List and
the number of persons who have been deemed
to be citizens of India on this basis; and
(d) the action taken on the observations
made by the Supreme Court in Writ Petition
No. 131/2000?
Decline in textile production
†*50. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that  textile
production in the powerloom, handloom
and hosiery sectors is continuously
declining in the country in the last few
years;
(b) if so, the sector-wise details of
textile production during 2005-06,
2006-07, 2007-08 and in first nine months
of 2008-09; and
(c) the sector-wise  number of
production units, closed after becoming sick
during the above period?
Issue of MNIC to check Bangladeshi
infiltrators
*51.PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Supreme Court has
recently directed the Union Government
to take immediate steps for issue of Multi-
purpose National Identity Cards (MNIC)
in the country to check the infiltration of
Bangladeshis;
(b) if so, whether the Bangladeshis
staying illegally in the country are having
Ration Cards, V oter Cards, PAN Cards etc.;
and
(c) if so, what initiatives would be taken
to ensure cent per cent exodus of
Bangladeshis from the country?

18
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Meeting of Chief Ministers of Naxal
hit States
*52. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether a meeting of Chief Ministers
of Naxal-hit States was held in the month of
January this year at New Delhi to formulate
latest strategies to combat Naxalism;
(b) if so, whether it has been decided to
provide guerrilla training to the personnel
of para-military forces to fight Naxalites;
(c) if so, to what extent Government
has started providing training to the para-
military forces; and
(d) the time by when such trained
personnel are likely to be deployed in the
Naxalite areas?
Low Squadron strength  of IAF
*53. SHRI N.K. SINGH:
SHRIMATI JAY A BACHCHAN:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the squadron
strength of Indian Air Force (IAF) is at an
all time low with only 32 fighter units
operational against the sanctioned strength
of 39.5 squadrons;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps taken by Government in
the matter?
Creating anti-Maoist force 'COBRA'
*54. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to create a
specialized anti-Maoist force 'COBRA' on
the lines of 'Greyhounds';
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether this project is proposed to
be funded by the Centre; and
(d) the time-frame within which this
force would be deployed in Orissa and
Jharkhand to control this menace?
Ban on import of Chinese toys
*55. SHRI BHARATKUMAR RAUT:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) what is the rationale behind the
decision of the Directorate General of
Foreign Trade in banning the import of
Chinese toys;
(b) whether it is a fact that there were
growing complaints about how safe they
were for children;
(c) what is the likely impact of the ban
on Indian market and society; and
(d) whether the Directorate is
contemplating to increase its scope and ban
more items from China?
Reduction in employment
opportunities
†*56. SHRI SHIVANAND TIWARI:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that no
employment opportunity has been
generated in the financial services,
information technology, retail sector, auto
industry, textile industry and real estate
sector in the first nine months of the year
2008-09;

19
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
(c) whether it is also a fact that reduction
has been made in the employment
opportunities in the above industrial sectors
during the said period; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Constitution of FIA for terrorist
incidents
†*57. SHRI KRISHAN LAL
BALMIKI: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
constitute a Federal Investigation Agency
(FIA) for investigation of terrorist
incidents and taking effective action;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether State Governments have
agreed to it?
Annual turnover in cotton and
readymade garments production
†*58. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI SHIV ANAND TIW ARI:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that many people
are employed in activities ranging from
cotton production to readymade garments
production in the country;
(b) if so, the average  annual turnover of
the industry;
(c) whether it is also a fact that taxes,
cess and additional taxes are collected by
Central and State Governments at different
levels from cotton production to stitching
of clothes in the industry; and
(d) if so, the levels at which tax, cess,
additional tax, etc. are collected, with type
and rate of each?
Mortality of workers due to
occupational diseases
*59. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the work related mortality
takes a toll of 4,00,000 Indian workers every
year and renders more than 3,50,000
workers unproductive because of
occupational diseases;
(b) whether India is a signatory to the
International Labour Organisation's (ILO's)
Promotional frame-work for Occupational
Safety and Health Convention; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Bangladeshi infiltrators deported to
Bangladesh
*60. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware about
the presence of good number of Bangladeshi
infiltrators;
(b) if so, the efforts being made to check
the infiltration identify the settled
infiltrators and deport them to Bangladesh;
and
(c) the number of Bangladeshi
infiltrators deported to Bangladesh during
the last three years?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 12th February, 2009 Secretary-General.
Magha 23, 1930 (Saka)

(Ministry-wise)
